The note conflicts with the assert in the task. Consecutive chunks of size 3 would give `[['a','b','c'], ...]`, but the assert expects `[['a','d','g','j','m'], ...]`, which is every nth element starting at each offset. I kept the strided version because it is the one that passes the assert.

```python
def list_split(lst, n):
    return [lst[i::n] for i in range(n)]
```
